title: Semiclassical Gravity Efficiently Solves NP-Complete Problems
summary: This arXiv pre-print proposes a theoretical framework using semiclassical gravity—combining quantum field theory with classical spacetime—to efficiently solve NP-Complete computational problems. The paper explores how gravitational effects might provide computational advantages beyond classical Turing machines, potentially leveraging quantum-classical hybrid dynamics to bypass conventional complexity barriers.
problem_solved: Proposes using gravitational physics to solve NP-Complete problems in polynomial time rather than exponential time.
why_valuable: If validated, this would represent a paradigm shift in computational complexity theory, potentially revolutionizing optimization, cryptography, and our fundamental understanding of computation's physical limits.
